Ayesha — appreciate the details. Below is a consolidated response and proposal we can include in the MAP document: 

Summary pricing (illustrative):
- Committed GPU pool: equivalent of 16 A100-80GB instances (we present as "40 vGPU units" for workload portability).
- 6-month term (staged commit): Base committed rate = $180,000/month. Staircase discounts: Month 1-2 (PoV ramp) billed at 60% of committed rate; Month 3-4 at 80%; from Month 5 onward full committed rate. Volume discount: 7% off list if you lock at month 3 for an additional 12-month extension.
- 12-month term: Base committed rate = $165,000/month (5% effective discount vs 6-month baseline). Additional multi-year pricing available on exec review.

PoV credits and acceptance:
- We'll provide a $50k PoV credit applied to the first invoice if acceptance criteria (latency p95 < 120 ms on 2k qps synthetic test; embedding cost < $X/token) are met.

Burst policy (proposal):
- Burst pool: up to 25% of committed capacity available for short bursts (max 4 hours/day) at a 1.4x premium on the marginal token unit price.
- Guaranteed burst SLA: Redwood guarantees >95% availability of burst capacity during scheduled maintenance windows; for unscheduled spikes we provide automatic fallback to a read-only lower-cost variant model with pre-agreed degrade thresholds (documented in MAP appendix).
- If burst capacity is unavailable beyond 6 cumulative hours in a billing month, CloudPark will receive service credits equal to 3% of that month's committed fee for each additional 2 hours of unavailability (capped at 25% of monthly fee).

Operational ramp (high-level):
- Week 0–4: PoV (25% reserved pool) — integration tests + 2 sprints of load tests.
- Week 5–12: Staircase to 100% reserved pool (additional 25% increments every 3 weeks).
- Month 4 onward: full production reservation, monitoring handover and runbook.

Next steps: update MAP doc with the two term options and the PoV credit line item; Ben, can you produce a line-item XLS for procurement? Stephanie, please capture legal lockpoints (SLA, credits, termination clause) for redline.
